subject: Post-call: Budget validation & $/1M token targets
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wilson <sam.wilson@finapp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@finapp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Budget validation & $/1M token targets

Hi Sam / Priya —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align internally and get a pricing/PO runbook to you next week.

Recap of what you shared:
- Typical monthly usage: ~15M generation tokens + ~50M embedding tokens (embedding batch jobs overnight).
- Expected growth: 2x in 6–9 months if POC goes well.
- Budget guidance shared on the call: target monthly spend band of $10k–$30k depending on model mix and latency needs.

Open items I promised to confirm:
1) Target $/1M tokens you’re aiming for (you mentioned benchmarking ~$1k per 1M tokens as a target for generation workloads) — can you confirm whether that $1k target is for generation only or blended across embeddings + generation?
2) Procurement thresholds: what approval level is required for monthly commitment bands? e.g., does anything >$25k/mo require VP-level signoff or a formal procurement RFQ?

If you can reply with a short line for each above (1 and 2) I’ll map to our commercial options (self-serve hosted vs. Dedicated reserved capacity vs. hybrid) and share a simple 1-page cost comparison.

Attaching a one-pager MAP template I promised for mutual action plan.

Attachments: 20250612-FinApp-MAP.xlsx (Excel, 22KB)

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sam Wilson <sam.wilson@finapp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@finapp.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget validation & $/1M token targets

Thanks Aditya — quick answers below.

1) The $1k / 1M tokens was a rough target for generation (chat/completion) workloads only. For embeddings we expect lower $/1M (we were thinking $100–$300 / 1M tokens) given the batch nature. For your modeling, please treat generation and embeddings separately.

2) Procurement thresholds: anything <= $15k/month can be approved by my director. $15k–$50k/month requires procurement review + VP sign-off (legal + security intake). Anything > $50k/month goes to executive review and we need an SOW + compliance package up front.

Hope that helps — happy to jump on a short call if that makes mapping easier.

Sam
Director of ML Infrastructure | FinApp
sam.wilson@finapp.com | +1 (617) 555-8899

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wilson <sam.wilson@finapp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@finapp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget validation & $/1M token targets

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Sam. I summarized the implications below and the two recommended commercial tracks based on your thresholds:

Summary (based on your numbers):
- Generation: target $1,000 / 1M tokens. At 15M gen tokens/mo -> ~$15k/mo. If usage doubles to 30M -> ~$30k/mo.
- Embeddings: target $200 / 1M tokens (midpoint). At 50M embeddings/mo -> ~$10k/mo.
- Blended current month estimate: $25k/mo (15M gen + 50M emb, using $1k and $200).

Commercial tracks:
A) Self-serve / hosted (no long-term commitment): unit pricing we quoted for hosted API; suitable if you want to start quickly and stay < $15k/mo initially to avoid procurement.
B) Dedicated / Reserved: recommended if you expect steady spend >= $25k/mo (predictable throughput, lower unit costs, and SSO + network controls). This is the path that eases exec approval if you present a committed monthly spend with an SOW — we can prepare a 6- or 12-month committed plan.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll draft two simple brackets in the MAP: (1) POC month (self-serve pricing) and (2) Committed plan for 6/12 months showing unit $/1M and expected monthly spend.
- Camila (cc'd) will surface procurement/contract cadence and a draft SOW.

Sam — before we pull a formal quote, can you confirm the range you expect to target for an initial committed plan (e.g., lower band $15k/mo, mid $25k/mo, upper $40k/mo)? That will help our pricing model and legal procurement templates.

Thanks —
Aditya

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wilson <sam.wilson@finapp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@finapp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget validation & $/1M token targets

Hi Sam / Priya —

Looping in procurement/commercial details and attaching a draft SOW and a simple quote grid.

Procurement checklist / thresholds (internal guidance we shared with similar customers):
- <$15k/month: standard MSA + PO. Minimal security intake (self-serve onboarding).
- $15k–$50k/month: requires procurement review, security questionnaire (we can provide SOC2 + pen test summary), and VP-level sign-off. Typical lead time 2–4 weeks depending on legal redlines.
- >$50k/month: executive-level approval + formal SOW + compliance package. We recommend a 6–12 month committed contract; Pricing tiers improve ~15–30% at scale.

Attached: redwood_sow_draft.pdf (SOW draft, 42KB) — includes proposed SLA, data handling notes and a 6/12 month committed pricing table.
Also attached: 20250612-FinApp-MAP.xlsx (updated)

If helpful, I can set up a brief procurement touchpoint next week (15–20m) to walk through required docs and expected timelines.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0210

Attachments: redwood_sow_draft.pdf (PDF, 42KB); 20250612-FinApp-MAP.xlsx (Excel, 25KB)

Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget validation & $/1M token targets

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. For the initial committed plan we should target the mid band: $25k/month (with view to scale to $40k+ within 6 months if POC metrics look good).

Please proceed with a 6-month committed quote at $25k/mo equivalent, and include the SOC2 docs + pen test summary. I’ll start the procurement ticket for VP sign-off.

Sam
